title: The AI Disclosure Paradox: Operational Disclosure and the Rise of Corporate AI Narratives
abstract: arXiv:2611.33201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-related corporate disclosure can expand while becoming less concentrated on current use. Across U.S. SEC filings from 2017 to 2025, AI-related passage intensity increased 6.3-fold between 2017-2022 and 2023-2025, whereas corrected operational-disclosure intensity increased 3.3-fold. The operational share fell from 25.76% to 13.45%; approximately 89% of the net increase in passage intensity fell outside the operational category. The decline persists within sectors and filing types and in 10-K-only analysis. These estimates combine frozen language-model predictions for 26,279 AI-related passages with an audit of 1,000 annotated passages. The findings distinguish growth in organizational attention from growth in implementation-specific claims: more operational disclosure can coexist with a substantially lower operational share. Operational disclosure was thus diluted, not displaced, by nonoperational disclosure. Reading corporate techn

translated_title: AI披露悖论：运营性披露与企业AI叙事的兴起
translated_abstract: 与AI相关的企业披露可以在规模扩张的同时变得更加不聚焦于当前的实际使用。在美国证监会（SEC）2017年至2025年的备案文件中，AI相关段落强度在2017-2022年与2023-2025年两个时期之间增长了6.3倍，而经校正的运营性披露强度仅增长了3.3倍。运营性占比从25.76%下降至13.45%；段落强度的净增长中约89%落在运营性类别之外。这一下降在各个行业内部、各类备案文件类型内部，以及仅限10-K年报的分析中均持续存在。这些估计结合了对26,279个AI相关段落的冻结语言模型预测，以及对1,000个标注段落的审计。研究结果表明，组织注意力的增长与具体实施声明的增长应加以区分：运营性披露数量的增加可以与运营性占比的显著下降并存。因此，运营性披露是被非运营性披露稀释了，而非被取代。（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究发现，尽管2017至2025年美国上市公司SEC文件中的AI披露内容增长了六倍多，但其中描述实际运营使用的占比反而从25.76%降至13.45%，表明AI披露的增长主要源于叙事性、非运营性表述的膨胀——运营性披露被稀释而非被取代。
en_tdlr: AI-related corporate disclosure in U.S. SEC filings grew over six-fold from 2017 to 2025, yet the share describing actual operational use fell from 25.76% to 13.45%, revealing that AI disclosure growth was driven largely by narrative claims rather than implementation-specific ones—operational disclosure was diluted, not displaced.
